liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (3 reviews): Reviewer names this as the highlight of the show; Other One and Truckin' are highlights; Jerry quotes many Truckin' riffs [11][15][20]
- **Lazy Lightning** (2 reviews): Lazy Lightning into Supplication is energetic, with Jerry playing the inner jam cleanly; Lazy Lightning into Supplication is a really good version [15][16]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Band plays a jazzy introduction of about five minutes before the song itself; Estimated Prophet and The Other One in the late second set are standouts [10][19]
- **Big River** (1 review): Big River and Mama Tried are excellent in a country-heavy first set [21]
- **Loser** (1 review): Jerry's voice problems become clear during Loser [21]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Tennessee Jed is weak vocally but still pretty good [21]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Main jam drifts with repetitive backing; Keith and Phil rescue it and steer into the Estimated Prophet entry jam [15]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Despite a tape flip in the first verse, it burns; Jerry turns unusually aggressive mid-jam [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Phil breaks a string - Bobby's Hunter joke**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **Tue Up**: rare: 6 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-01-06.sbd.wizard.24629.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 149 min; rated 3.25/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Tape hiss reduced with light filtering; first set EQ'd for more mids and highs, second set left alone [1]
- **gd1978-01-06.153175.sbd.menke.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 159 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Intermittent 60Hz hum removed from set two; vocals fade in and out at the start [2]
- **gd1978-01-06.170740.sbd.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 159 min [3]
- **gd78-01-06.sbd.clugston.6953.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 148 min; rated 3.73/5 by 15 [5]. Said about its sound: Final mix could use more bass and less treble, though the sound beats other shows from the same period [10]

## Around the show

- Phil breaks a string during the show [17]
- Reviewer calls it a good example of one of Donna's last shows [17]
- Reviewer notes Donna's final show came in February 1979, over a year later [20]
- Jerry has laryngitis and his voice is gone by Deal [1]
- Garcia had laryngitis, his voice was shot by Deal, and he did not sing in set two [2]
- Garcia had laryngitis, so there are no Jerry vocals in the second set [3]
- Show two nights later in San Diego has stronger guitar backing on Bob's songs; reviewer rates this one short and dull [13]
- Other One into Truckin' reverses the more usual Truckin' into Other One order [16]
- Truckin' is perhaps rivaled only by the 11/6/77 version; rest of show is average [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-01-06.sbd.wizard.24629.sbeok.shnf**: source: MC>RR>DAT>CD>EAC>DC5>CD [1]. Also: Audience patches fill a tape flip in Looks Like Rain, the second-set intro and part of The Other One [1]
- **gd1978-01-06.153175.sbd.menke.sirmick.flac16**: transferred by Bob Menke, SIRMick; source: Sbd > Cassette Master > Cassette (1st gen) [2]. Also: Audience patches in Looks Like Rain and The Other One come from other circulating sources [2]
- **gd1978-01-06.170740.sbd.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: transferred by Bob Menke, Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > Bob Menke's first generation cassettes [3]. Also: An AKG D224E audience source supplies patches in Looks Like Rain and The Other One [3]
- **gd78-01-06.sbd.clugston.6953.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Master soundboard cassette, copied to cassette, then DAT, then CDR, and shn-encoded by Scott Clugston [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Mason's Children: [January Grateful Dead Show Listening Guides](https://www.gratefuldeadbook.com/post/january-grateful-dead-show-reviews) [23]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1978-01-06 Swing Auditorium, San Bernardino, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-01-06-swing-auditorium-san-bernardino-ca-usa/) [24]
